aaa_enabled.summary: Enable RADIUS or TACACS+ management authentication client.
aaa_enabled.notes: Always verify you have a valid local administration account configured before enabling remote authentication.

secure_vty_transport.summary: Disable Telnet access server on the switch.
secure_vty_transport.notes: SSHv2 should be used exclusively. Telnet transmits sensitive credentials in cleartext.

vty_idle_timeout.summary: Configure CLI inactivity session timeout to 10 minutes or less, and enable the timer.
vty_idle_timeout.notes: The configuration parameter is in minutes (10 minutes = 600 seconds).

enable_secret_encrypted.summary: Ensure all configured accounts use encrypted passwords.
enable_secret_encrypted.notes: EXOS automatically hashes and encrypts passwords in configuration storage.

no_default_snmp_community.summary: Delete default SNMP community names public and private.
no_default_snmp_community.notes: Default community names are widely known and pose a severe security threat.

http_server_disabled.summary: Disable the unencrypted web HTTP management interface.
http_server_disabled.notes: Only use HTTPS for web-based switch administration.

ssh_version_2.summary: Enable SSHv2 server on the switch.
ssh_version_2.notes: Ensure that the SSH module is installed on the switch before enabling.

logging_enabled.summary: Configure a remote syslog server target and enable it.
cli: enable log target syslog <syslog-ip> vr VR-Default
logging_enabled.notes: A remote syslog host guarantees that log records are preserved independently.

management_acl.summary: Apply access profiles to restrict management SSH2 and Telnet access.
management_acl.notes: Verify that your current administrative workstation IP is permitted by the access profile.

login_banner.summary: Configure a pre-login banner message warning unauthorized users.
login_banner.notes: Banner configurations typically require multiline text input followed by an empty line.

password_min_length.summary: Configure account password policy minimum length to 8 or more, and enable complexity validation.
cli: configure account all password-policy char-validation all-char-groups
password_min_length.notes: Enabling character validation requires passwords to draw from uppercase, lowercase, numeric, and special character groups.

ntp_configured.summary: Configure an NTP server and enable the NTP client.
cli: configure ntp server add <ntp-ip> vr VR-Default
ntp_configured.notes: System time synchronization is crucial for accurate audit log chronology.

no_write_snmp_community.summary: Configure all SNMP communities to readonly access only.
no_write_snmp_community.notes: Avoid using SNMP write communities. Prefer SNMPv3 for write configuration options.
